title: Spring Temple Buddha
summary: The Spring Temple Buddha is a colossal Buddha statue in Lushan County, Henan, China. It opened in 2008 after 11 years of work. Its operator gives 128 metres from the base of the lotus pedestal, or 208 metres with the two seats beneath it, and Sixth Tone described it as the tallest Buddha statue in the world.

uncertainty.note: Sixth Tone: opened in 2008 and took 11 years to complete, so work began about 1997 (not stated as a year on the page). The start year used here is the opening. End is the present: the statue stands.

as_recorded.value: Opened in 2008, the Spring Temple Buddha is located in Lushan County
